sentences.text:
=
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Alok Kumar Agrawal, Advocate
 For the Respondents : Mr. A.P.Singh (Sc-15)
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Vikash Jain
 Oral Order

At the outset, learned counsel for the petitioner limits the relief sought for in the present writ petition only to paragraph 1(i) of the writ petition with regard to unsealing a part of the factory premises of the petitioner-Company which was sealed.
The remaining reliefs including the prayer for quashing of the first information report are not pressed and learned counsel for the petitioner seeks to withdraw the same, which is permitted.

2. It has been submitted that the respondents have illegally sealed a part of the factory premises,
pursuant to the institution of the FIR, without there being any authority to seal the factory premises either under the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 nor under the Code of Criminal Procedure.
3. Learned counsel for the respondents prays for and is granted two weeks' time to file a counter affidavit in this regard.
Let the matter be listed after two weeks.

(Vikash Jain, J) B.T/-
